title: SwiftFlame
description: Supercharge your campfire! Place any vanilla campfire on top of a Magma Block to cook food at extreme, turbo-charged speeds.
body:
Tired of waiting for ages just to cook a few pieces of meat on a regular campfire? Say no more! SwiftFlame is a lightweight, performance-friendly Fabric mod designed to supercharge your survival cooking experience without breaking the game's vanilla immersion.
 Key Features
**Magma Infusion:** Place any vanilla Campfire directly on top of a Magma Block, and watch the flames turn into a high-speed cooking machine!

**Extreme Cooking Speeds:** Food cooks at a turbo-charged rate, flying off the grill almost instantly. Perfect for busy miners and adventurers who don't have time to waste.

**Fully Server-Side Compatible:** Works flawlessly in single-player worlds and dedicated multiplayer servers. No lag, just pure speed.

**In-Game Commands:** Control and tweak the mod's mechanics directly using easy-to-use custom commands.

You can manage the mod using the following built-in game commands:

/swiftflame magmaspeed <value> — Sets the cooking speed multiplier for campfires placed on top of a Magma Block.

/swiftflame normalspeed <value> — Sets the base cooking speed multiplier for regular campfires.

**📦 Installation & Requirements**
Minecraft Version: 1.20.1

Mod Loader: Fabric Loader (Highly compatible with older and newer loader versions!)

 Dependencies: Fabric Api

 Forge/NeoForge Port: I am planning to port the mod to Forge and NeoForge in the future so more players can enjoy it!
 
 More Minecraft Versions: Support for other popular Minecraft versions is on the way!
